# Order desk — how the week gets locked

Standing orders roll. Nobody confirms them weekly.

Variations taken until 14:00 Thursday for the week starting the following
Monday. Email or phone, both go in the order desk sheet.

14:00 Thursday is the lock. Flour goes on order Thursday afternoon against the
locked list. That is why the deadline is not a courtesy.

After the lock: increases only if flour allows, charged at line price with no
volume tier. Decreases are still invoiced. Same answer every time.

Bench list printed Friday morning. It does not change after that.

Recurring problem: cafes ring on Friday about a festival or a closure. The
answer above is the answer.
